test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: G's mother is the only daughter of K. N is the son of F and K. H is the son of N and M. F is the father's father of H. How is K related to H?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599c31a3b6c5ca06ce1787b908a152975e0540fada6e60ee63a4282f38f5a661.png] 

Family Tree :

1) N is the son of F and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07ccdcf9c0e669f377194b43157359a200d68fe01a42ade7872114ef65bca720.png] 

2) H is the son of N and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa6d6fd6d988d91748e621f05e9d0567819708fa88698ca692c404e9d66d89c6.png] 

3) F is the father's father of H and G's mother is the only daughter of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f0bc75bd8e02245749166e9edc9425995f2d86735beef7220c1ae1d51c3fca9.png] 

∴ Here, 'K is grand mother of H' or 'K is father's mother of H'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Father's mother".**
